review_summary: Comprehensive independent external audit of 9702_m22_42 Question 6 across all 4 leaves. Rigorously verified electromagnetic induction and solenoid magnetic properties: (a) magnetic flux comparison (Phi = BA, flux is less in smaller solenoid due to its smaller cross-sectional area, 1 mark, B1); (b) magnetic flux density comparison (greater in smaller solenoid due to higher turns per unit length/concentration of field, 1 mark, B1); (c)(i) precise formal statement of Lenz's law (direction of induced e.m.f. is such as to oppose the change producing/causing it, 2 marks, M1 + A1); (c)(ii) complete causal explanation of why an attractive magnetic force acts on the smaller solenoid as switch opens (decay of magnetic flux in larger solenoid induces an e.m.f. and current in smaller solenoid, generating a magnetic field whose interaction with the primary field produces an attractive force opposing the reduction in flux, 3 marks, B1 + B1 + B1). All syllabus learning outcomes (9702_t20_m05_o01, 9702_t20_m04_o02, 9702_t20_m05_o05), skill taxonomies, formula/definition registries, hints, walkthroughs, response schemas, and AI rubrics perfectly match CAIE official paper and mark scheme with zero defects.
